text:
jackie: quick question — were planning to extend retention for certain incident snapshots from 30d to 90d. who owns RBAC + KMS unwrap for short-lived analyst access?

maria: Ill take RBAC. propose a scoped role `roles/siem.snapshotViewer` limited to project `security-audit` and dataset label `siem:triage`.

kevin: KMS unwrap is gated: all unwraps must go through `kms-proxy` with ticket enforcement. we should keep unwraps ephemeral and auditable.

jackie: can we make an oncall-friendly flow so analysts can request access during incident reviews without waking infra at 3am?

security-oncall: suggestion: ticket -> auto-approve for oncall when severity >= P2 and incident owner signs off -> ephemeral role grant (4h) -> kms-proxy unwrap -> audit webhook. low-touch but fully logged.

maria: example ticket fields: 
- requester: <email>
- incident_id: <INC-2026-123>
- justification: "triage: heap dump + netflow"
- dataset: "siem-snapshots/INC-2026-123"
- duration: 4h
- scrub_required: yes/no

kevin: kms-proxy snippet: 
proxy:
  allowed_principals: ["roles/siem.snapshotViewer"]
  unwrap_ttl: 4h
  audit_webhook: https://hooks.redwood.internal/security/kms-unwrap
  require_ticket: true

jackie: on the retention side we must constrain which snapshots get 90d. gate by tag `triage:true` and origin `incident.created_by:security`. update handbook + legal.

maria: will add policy + automated tagger in pipeline to mark qualifying snapshots.

devops: I can automate IAM bindings: create short-lived binding with `gcloud` and auto-revoke. sample: `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding security-audit --member=user:analyst@redwood.com --role=roles/siem.snapshotViewer --condition='expression=request.ticket_id != null, title="temp-snapshot-access"'`

security-oncall: ensure SIEM exports are scrubbed before any third-party access; mandatory scrub stage masking PII.

kevin: add pre-export scrub job + checksum audit. store pre-scrub hashes in a KMS-wrapped envelope for later integrity checks.

jackie: want to run in staging first and put a runbook together for oncall (approve, revoke, alerts).

maria: creating runbook and PR: https://git.internal/redwood/security/merge_requests/542 (WIP)

sre-bot: [deploy-bot] staging automation deployed to staging-project at 2025-06-03T02:45:00Z :rocket:

devops: lambda for automation deployed to staging pointing at `kms-proxy-staging` and `tagger-staging`. test plan: 1) create test incident 2) file request 3) validate ephemeral grant 4) confirm KMS unwrap logged.

jackie: scheduled test tomorrow 09:00 PT. @security-oncall please add acceptance criteria.

security-oncall: will add checks: audit webhook present, scrubbed fields validated, ticket linked to grant, legal looped for 90d.

maria: PR for policy + runbook created, awaiting review.

devops: after PR merge Ill gate prod rollout behind `feature/triage-90d` and keep opt-in via `triage=true` until legal signs off.

jackie: action items: maria -> policy + runbook; kevin -> scrub + kms audit; devops -> staging -> prod rollout; security-oncall -> acceptance criteria + legal contact. :white_check_mark:

kevin: also adding a nightly smoke test to confirm unwrap logs are shipped to `sec-audit` stream.

sre-bot: [audit-bot] ticket #SEC-742 created and linked to PR.

jackie: thanks everyone. follow-ups in the MR thread.
